reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com). It hasn't been sent, so it's in your drafts for you to check and send.

- **Subject:** "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- **Body:** It gives the rate as $2,101 a seat, says the figure came from Marcus Lindqvist and that you approved sharing it with Hollis. It also asks Hollis to treat it as a finance figure.

You're the CFO, so your approval covers sending this rate to Hollis. No further approval was needed, and the address is internal. I couldn't check the $2,101 against a Thornbury contract because none of the files I can see for you include one, so I used the figure exactly as you gave it.

I've also confirmed this to you in our DM.
